name: researcher
description: The research agent with a memory. By default it hands analyses to parallel helpers and has every finding it stages re-run and refereed before you accept it; both are switches, and a planner splits the work into packages when you turn it on.
greeting:
Researcher: one research agent with a memory and, by default, helpers.

Run `claude` or `pi` here, whichever this project carries. By default the
agent hands analyses to analysts that run in parallel, on the data folders you
gave the project, and keeps its own memory under /workspace/memory/. Read what
it has for you in the Reader tab: README.md, the front page (what waits for
you, what is running, where things stand, what is known); staging/, the claims
waiting for you; results/, what you accepted; logbook/, the story of the work,
one entry per topic, written when you type /log. The agent writes these pages;
do not edit them.

By default a finding can be accepted only once it was re-run and an
independent referee read it; its page shows what both found. Accept it by
saying "accept F-3". The helpers and the checks are switches: the project's
settings say what a new session starts with, and /rs-mode (/skill:rs-mode in
pi) switches them for one session.

With the planner on, claude or pi opens a work session: it takes the only
free work package, or lists the free ones, or says there is nothing to work
on. claude-plan (pi-plan in pi) starts the planning session, and
claude-work <package> (pi-work <package>) a work session on one package, each
on its role's model; /rs-plan and /rs-work <package> (/skill:rs-plan,
/skill:rs-work <package> in pi) take the same roles in a running session.
